record.context_brief: Two bounded diagonal rays without bounded full orbit
record.original_question: Let A be the group of all diagonal matrices in SL(3,R), and let A1 and A2 be rays in A. Does there exist x∈SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z) such that A1x and A2x are bounded but the full Ax orbit is not bounded?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 43. Let A be the group of all diagonal matrices in SL(3, R), and A1, A2 ⊂ A be rays in A. Then there exists x ∈ SL(3, R)/SL(3, Z) such that A 1x and A2x are bounded, but Ax is not bounded in SL(3, R)/SL(3, Z).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{R})$, let $\Gamma=\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{Z})$, and consider the homogeneous space $G/\Gamma$ with its natural topology (a subset is bounded if it is relatively compact). Let $A\subset G$ be the group of all diagonal matrices with positive entries and determinant $1$, viewed as a $2$-dimensional connected abelian subgroup acting on $G/\Gamma$ by left multiplication. By a "ray" in $A$ we mean a one-parameter semigroup of the form $\{\exp(tv):t\geq 0\}$ for some nonzero $v$ in the Lie algebra of $A$.

Prove or disprove: for every pair of rays $A_1,A_2\subset A$, there exists a point $x\in G/\Gamma$ such that the orbits $A_1 x$ and $A_2 x$ are both bounded in $G/\Gamma$, while the full orbit $Ax$ is not bounded in $G/\Gamma$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a conjecture about diagonal actions on SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z) closely related to the Margulis bounded-orbits framework. Recent surveys and papers (e.g., An–Guan on bounded orbits, and 2025 work on bounded diagonal orbits over function fields) discuss the conjecture but do not announce a resolution; the conjecture appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: Bounded Orbits of Homogeneous Dynamics — An, Guan
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on bounded orbits of diagonal flows on SL_n(R)/SL_n(Z), discussing Margulis-type conjectures and current status.
status_evidence.claim: Survey lists the existence of points with partial bounded ray-orbits but unbounded full diagonal orbit as a problem in the area without claiming resolution.

status_evidence.title: Bounded diagonal orbits in homogeneous spaces over function fields
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) paper exploring bounded diagonal orbits in analogous settings.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate bounded diagonal orbits, indicating the conjecture remains an active open question.
